documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Board Meeting Intimation for Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Antelopus Selan reported its Q2 FY27 financial and operational results, highlighting production figures and portfolio expansion plans. Management noted continuous drilling activity in the Cambay Basin alongside development progress in KG Onland assets following DSF-IV licence awards. The company outlined growth targets aiming for an onshore portfolio of 5,000+ boepd by FY29. Additionally, operational updates detailed progress in Bakrol and Karjisan wells, supported by favorable fiscal terms. Antelopus Selan Energy Limited reported its Q1 FY27 results, highlighting continuous drilling execution ahead of schedule with 9 out of 10 planned FDP wells drilled in Bakrol and strong EBITDA growth reaching c.

guidance.claim: Management targets an exit production rate of 2,500 boepd for FY27.
guidance.quote: Key takeaways: On track for a 2,500 boepd exit

guidance.claim: The company maintains its guidance of reaching 2,500 boepd in FY27.
guidance.quote: Our guidance of reaching 2,500 boepdin FY’27 remains intact, as impact from Frac will be seen from Q2 onwards

guidance.claim: Management provided a roadmap to 2,500+ boepd in FY27 starting from a base of 1,800+ boepd.
guidance.quote: We begin our FY 27 with a base of 1800+ boepd with a road map to 2500+ boepd in FY ‘27

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Volume-driven growth despite a challenging pricing environment

capex_expansion.claim: Continuous capex cycle is planned in the Cambay Basin for the next 3 to 4 years.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuous Capex cycle in Cambay Basin for the next 3–4 years, while KG ramps up to deliver year-on-year growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Karjisan has 2 of the 7 planned wells drilled ahead of schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Ahead of schedule: 2 of the 7 wells drilled, well before the planned Q4 first spud

capex_expansion.claim: Drilling is set to commence in the Cambay basin by the end of FY27.
A second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY27 to build further on the ramp-up momentum.
capex_expansion.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

capex_expansion.claim: Remaining 8 wells at Bakrol are drilling to complete in H1 CY2026 with full ramp-up to follow through mid-year.
capex_expansion.quote: Remaining 8 wells drilling to complete in H1 CY2026; full ramp-up to follow through mid-year

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA was reported at Rs 167.5 Cr with an EBITDA margin of 59%, while Profit After Tax was up by approximately 27% at INR 89.6 Cr.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Rs 167.5 Cr. (c. +14%) & EBITDA margin at 59% ; Profit After Tax at INR 89.6Cr,up(c.+27%);

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 sales volumes were reported at 1656 boepd.
9 of 10 planned FDP wells have been drilled so far in Bakrol.
Average sales for Q1 FY27 were c. 1705 boepd.

capital_allocation.claim: Continued reinvestment is planned from operating cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Continued reinvestment from operating cash flow

capital_allocation.claim: Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21-FY23 of c. 6.56 Cr.
capital_allocation.quote: Commissioner (Appeals) allowed the Company's refund claim for excess Cess paid in FY21–FY23, of c. ₹6.56 Cr. whichwasearlierexpense.

risks_headwinds.claim: Custody transfer to IOCL ran for only ~86-87 days this quarter resulting in a crude inventory build-up.
risks_headwinds.quote: Custody transfer to IOCL ran for only ~86–87 days this quarter, and resulted in a build-up of c. 6,500 bopd of crude inventory during the Quarter.

management_commitments.claim: All 7 wells in Karjisan are scheduled to be drilling by April 2027.
management_commitments.quote: All 7 wells to be drilling by April 2027

management_commitments.claim: Continuous frac campaign is set to commence in early August in Bakrol with full productivity expected in Q2.
Drilling in the Cambay field is planned for H2 FY27 targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir.
management_commitments.quote: The next well is planned for H2 FY'27, targeting the deeper Eocene reservoir in the Western/Central part of the block.

management_commitments.claim: A second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Second new well is planned for Cambay in H2 FY’27, to build further on the ramp-up momentum

management_commitments.claim: Remaining 8 wells at Bakrol are scheduled to complete drilling in H1 CY2026.
management_commitments.quote: Remaining 8 wells drilling to complete in H1 CY2026; full ramp-up to follow through mid-year

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
